dashboard.label: SNMP — Splunk Connect (SC4SNMP)
dashboard.description: SNMP fleet at a glance: which devices are polled, live poll activity, and pushed traps (decoded into device / event / message).

search.query: index=berlin_snmp OR index=london_snmp (sourcetype=sc4snmp:event OR sourcetype=sc4snmp:metric) | eval ip=replace(host,":.*","") | stats dc(ip)
| tstats count as c where index=berlin_snmp OR index=london_snmp | eval v=if(c>0,1,0) | fields v

index=berlin_snmp OR index=london_snmp (sourcetype=sc4snmp:event OR sourcetype=sc4snmp:metric) | eval ip=replace(host,":.*","") | eval Device=case(ip=="198.18.3.11","proxmox-berlin", ip=="198.18.3.32","cat8kv-berlin", ip=="198.18.2.32","cat8kv-london", ip=="198.18.2.11","desktop-london", ip=="198.18.3.52","ubuntu-berlin-snmp", 1==1,ip) | stats count as "Poll points" latest(_time) as last by Device ip | eval "Last seen"=strftime(last,"%F %T"), mins=round((now()-last)/60,1) | eval Status=if(mins<15,"● polling","○ stale") | rename ip as IP | table Device IP "Poll points" "Last seen" Status | sort Device

index=berlin_snmp OR index=london_snmp sourcetype=sc4snmp:traps | rex field=_raw "snmpTrapOID[^}]*?\"value\":\s*\"(?<Trap>[^\"]+)\"" | rex field=_raw "sysDescr[^}]*?\"value\":\s*\"(?<Message>[^\"]+)\"" | rex field=_raw "sysName[^}]*?\"value\":\s*\"(?<TrapName>[^\"]+)\"" | eval ip=replace(host,":.*","") | eval Device=case(ip=="198.18.3.11","proxmox-berlin", ip=="198.18.3.32","cat8kv-berlin", ip=="198.18.2.32","cat8kv-london", ip=="198.18.2.11","desktop-london", ip=="198.18.3.52","ubuntu-berlin-snmp", 1==1,ip) | eval Trap=coalesce(Trap,"(trap)"), Message=coalesce(Message,TrapName,"-") | eval State=case(match(Trap,"(?i)linkDown|coldStart|DOWN"),"● down", match(Trap,"(?i)linkUp|warmStart|UP"),"● up", 1==1,"○ info") | eval Event=replace(Trap,".*::","") | table _time Device Event Message State | sort - _time

panel.title: Poll vs trap activity over time

search.query: index=berlin_snmp OR index=london_snmp | eval kind=if(sourcetype=="sc4snmp:traps","traps (push)","poll (GET)") | timechart span=5m count by kind

html.p: Two modes: poll (GET) — SC4SNMP asks each device on UDP 161 every ~5 min (system, interfaces, CPU/mem). traps (push) — a device sends an event to UDP 162 the instant it happens (linkDown/Up, restart) — the real-time signal. Fleet: Proxmox, both Catalyst routers, and a Linux host (edit inventory.csv to add more). Regional/RBAC: Berlin → berlin_snmp, London → london_snmp.
